focus: 壞消息先講、承擔、再給復原方案
lead: 今天練的是升級與壞消息：資料壞了、時程要滑了，而你必須主動去講。心法一句 —— 先講衝擊、承擔責任、再帶方案，最後要一個決定。不要鋪陳、不要過度道歉。每個 speaking 段落請先出聲講完再看解答。

phrases.en: I need to flag something before it gets worse.
phrases.gl: 我要先示警（主動開口，而不是被問出來）
phrases.ex: I need to flag something before it gets worse — we have a timestamp problem in the last six weeks of rosbags.

phrases.en: Here's the impact first, then the cause.
phrases.gl: 先講影響再講原因（主管要的是損失規模，不是技術細節）
phrases.ex: Here's the impact first, then the cause: about 40% of the highway set is unusable for training right now.

phrases.en: Here's what we know, and here's what we don't know yet.
phrases.gl: 把已知和未知分開（誠實但不失控，避免亂承諾）
phrases.ex: Here's what we know: the sync board firmware drifted. Here's what we don't know yet: whether the GNSS logs are affected too.

phrases.en: We caught it on Tuesday. Since then we've…
phrases.gl: 交代發現時間與你已經做的事（證明你不是坐在那裡等）
phrases.ex: We caught it on Tuesday. Since then we've frozen new collection runs and re-verified two of the four vehicles.

phrases.en: I'd rather tell you now than at the review.
phrases.gl: 我寧可現在講，也不要在檢討會上才爆（把壞消息框成專業判斷）
phrases.ex: I'd rather tell you now than at the review on the 14th, when there'd be nothing left to do about it.

phrases.en: The recovery plan has three parts.
phrases.gl: 復原方案分三塊（用結構讓對方感覺事情有被掌握）
phrases.ex: The recovery plan has three parts: stop the bleeding, re-collect the critical scenarios, and add a daily integrity check.

phrases.en: The realistic date is X, not Y.
phrases.gl: 務實日期是 X，不是 Y（重設期待，一次到位，不要分三次滑）
phrases.ex: The realistic date is the 28th, not the 14th — and I'd rather move it once than move it three times.

phrases.gl: 這件事我扛（一句話承擔，然後立刻轉向行動）
phrases.ex: I own this one — the integrity check was on my backlog and I let it sit. It's in the pipeline as of this morning.
phrases.fix: 取代 "Sorry for the inconvenience caused by us"

phrases.en: What I need from you is a decision on X by Y.
phrases.gl: 我需要你在什麼時間前決定什麼（升級要帶著明確的請求）
phrases.ex: What I need from you is a decision by Friday: do we hold the date and cut two scenarios, or move the delivery two weeks?

setup: Setup. On Tuesday your team found that a firmware regression on the camera sync board has been writing drifting hardware timestamps since late June. Roughly 40% of the highway rosbags from the last six weeks can't be used for training — the camera and radar frames don't line up. The milestone review is on the 14th and the customer expects a delivery on the 15th. You have four test vehicles, two collection slots a week, and the labeling vendor is already booked solid. David, the program manager, does not know yet. You are going to tell him this morning.

prompts.q: You open the call with David. He has no idea anything is wrong.
prompts.frame: Flag it up front → impact in one number → cause in one line → what you've already done → what comes next.
prompts.say: 先出聲講完整段（目標 40 秒），不要用道歉開場，再看 model answer。
prompts.model: “David, I need to flag something before we go through the rest of the agenda. Impact first: about 40% of the highway rosbags from the last six weeks aren't usable for training — camera and radar timestamps have drifted apart, so the frames don't line up. The cause is a firmware regression on the sync board that went in at the end of June. We caught it Tuesday afternoon. Since then we've frozen new collection, rolled the firmware back on all four cars, and re-verified two of them clean. What I don't know yet is whether the GNSS logs drifted with it — I'll have that answer by tomorrow. I'd rather bring you this now than at the review on the 14th.”

prompts.q: David: “Six weeks? How does something like this run for six weeks without anyone catching it?”
prompts.frame: Answer the question directly → own your part without collapsing → name the real gap in the process → say what has already changed.
prompts.say: 出聲練習「承擔但不自我貶低」，30 秒內講完，禁止連續道歉。
prompts.model: “Fair question, and the honest answer is we had no automated check on timestamp alignment — we only looked at it when someone hit a problem downstream. That check was on my backlog since May and I let it sit behind the collection push. So I own this one. The other half is that the firmware update went in through the vehicle team's normal maintenance window and we weren't in that loop, which we should have been. Two things have already changed: an integrity check now runs on every bag at ingest and fails loudly, and I'm on the firmware change notification list as of this morning. If this happens again, we'd know inside a day, not six weeks.”

prompts.q: David: “Okay. The customer expects the delivery on the 15th. What do you want to do?”
prompts.frame: Give the realistic date → lay out two concrete options with what each costs → say which one you'd pick and why → ask for the decision with a deadline.
prompts.say: 出聲講一次完整的復原提案，結尾一定要有一個明確的請求。
prompts.model: “The realistic date for the full set is the 28th, not the 15th. Two options. Option one: we hold the 15th and ship a reduced set — clean urban and night data, but we drop the highway cut-in and lane-change scenarios, which are the two the customer cares most about. Option two: we move to the 28th and re-collect the highway scenarios properly — that's eight collection slots over two weeks, and the labeling vendor can absorb it if we book by Monday. I'd take option two. Shipping a set that's missing cut-ins doesn't actually help their evaluation, and we'd end up re-collecting anyway in September. What I need from you is a decision by Friday, because the vendor slot has to be booked Monday morning. And if you want, I'll draft the note to the customer today so you're not the one breaking it cold.”

fixes.bad: Until now we don't find the root cause yet.
fixes.good: We haven't found the root cause yet.
fixes.note: Tense：從過去持續到現在的狀態要用現在完成式 have/has + p.p.；中文的「到目前為止」不需要翻成 until now，yet 已經涵蓋了。

fixes.bad: The problem was happened since three weeks.
fixes.good: The problem has been there for about three weeks.
fixes.note: Voice + preposition：happen 是不及物動詞，不能用被動 was happened；一段時間長度用 for，不用 since（since 後面接時間點，例如 since June）。

fixes.bad: I want to inform you there is serious problem in the data.
fixes.good: I want to flag a serious problem with the data.
fixes.note: Article + preposition + register：problem 前面要有冠詞 a；problem 搭配的介係詞是 with，不是 in。inform you 太公文腔，會議裡用 flag 更自然也更有行動感。

fixes.bad: We will try to catch up the schedule, hope everything is okay.
fixes.good: We'll recover about a week by adding weekend collection slots. I'll confirm the new date on Friday.
fixes.note: Vagueness：try / hope 在壞消息場合等於什麼都沒承諾，聽的人只會更焦慮。壞消息一定要配「具體動作 + 具體日期」。

fixes.bad: Sorry for my mistake, I feel very bad about this, please forgive us.
fixes.good: This one's on me. Here's what I've changed so it can't repeat.
fixes.note: Register：英文職場的道歉是「一句承擔 + 立刻轉向修正」；連續道歉或請求原諒會讓對方覺得你已經失去掌控，反而降低信任。

challenge:
今天在真實會議或訊息中做這一件事：把一件正在惡化的小事，主動先講出來，用這個順序 ——

“I need to flag ___. The impact is ___. We caught it ___, and since then we've ___. What I need from you is ___ by ___.”

錄音作業（60 秒，手機錄）：挑一個你手上真的有風險的項目，用英文練習一次升級。

  • 前 10 秒之內必須講出衝擊（含一個數字或比例）
  • 必須有一句承擔（I own this one 或 That was my call），但只講一次
  • 結尾必須是一個帶日期的請求，不能是 please kindly advise
  • 禁用：sorry 超過一次、try our best、hope everything is okay
check: 我有沒有在開口的前 10 秒就講出衝擊，而不是先鋪陳背景？
我承擔責任的時候，是一句話帶過就轉向行動，還是重複道歉？
我這次升級有沒有帶著「兩個選項 + 我的建議 + 一個帶日期的請求」？
